sentences.ar: قال: أنا وموريارتي وقفنا على الحافة.
sentences.en: He said: Moriarty and I stood at the edge.

sentences.ar: كنت بعرف مصارعة، وهو ما كان بيعرف.
sentences.en: I knew a wrestling art, and he did not.

sentences.ar: وقتها فكرت: إذا الناس حسبوني ميت، بضل عايش.
sentences.en: Then I thought: if people believe me dead, I stay alive.

sentences.ar: لأنه كان في اتنين من رجاله لسا برا.
sentences.en: Because two of his men were still at large.
I travelled and changed my name and kept watching.

sentences.ar: قلت له: كان بقدر أسكت لو قلت لي.
sentences.en: I said to him: I could have kept silent if you had told me.
